newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices drop on poor mill demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices drop on poor mill demand.

text.p: Indian cotton prices on Thursday fell on poor mill demand and in the absence of any announcement by the government regarding more cotton exports, dealers said.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi fell by 10 rupees at 880/920 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned moved down by 10/30 rupees at 1,560/1,660 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell by 200 rupees to 12,600/13,000 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).

Dealer Chandubhai Thakkar said that reports that the government is considering a proposal to allow more exports of value added cotton yarn and fabrics prior to raw cotton also subdued market sentiment.
